g.title: j4141893246
g.text: PapaPolar: 雪人為什麼要去接受治療？

g.title: j638866612
g.text: 所以我們現在在講老爸笑話嗎？

g.title: j1180722454
g.text: PapaPolar: 因為他……徹底崩潰了

g.title: j2342341963
g.text: 對啊我寧願在東西上打洞，對不起。 [結束]

g.title: j969463732
g.text: 哈哈。好。雪人為什麼要去接受治療？

g.title: j2997776330
g.text: PapaPolar: 這是我聽過的最悲傷的事……

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank5Convo3.

j3567095394
g.text: PapaPolar: 試想一下，一個雪球上面又有一個更大的雪球而這個雪球上面又有一個更大的雪球。

g.title: j1455984313
g.text: PapaPolar: with two pieces of coal for eyes and a big 'ol carrot for a nose

g.title: j3233960862
g.text: PapaPolar: Why was the snowman looking through the carrots?

g.title: j3065494341
g.text: And that's supposed to look like a human?

g.title: j1473658397
g.text: 我……需要去拯救世界。或是……跟邪惡搏鬥……或是……整理我的襪子……或是其他什麼。[結束]

g.title: j259170327
g.text: PapaPolar: i mean, yes? but no? it's not the point - it's a thing people do when -

g.title: j159331368
g.text: MomToxicated: 當下雪時，世界漸漸慢下來，在戶外做這件事很有趣。

g.title: j1570516910
g.text: MomToxicated: And "ball" is an easy shape to make with snow.

g.title: j2272470599
g.text: PapaPolar: 該死。我忘了。該死的。

g.title: j378391696
g.text: MomToxicated: Besides. They're cheery looking, when everything is cold and bleak.

g.title: j2739526823
g.text: MomToxicated: 因為他當時正在挖鼻孔。

g.title: j733848619
g.text: PapaPolar: 我很樂意救你怎麼做。 :-D

g.title: j2679053656
g.text: PapaPolar: why did the snowman go to therapy?

g.title: j1974833785
g.text: MomToxicated: You told that to the foreign delegation committee when we were in Cité de la Lumière.

g.title: j1448235465
g.text: PapaPolar: oh right! hahhaha. i forgot all about that trip. i thought you were too busy slipping poison into the chancellor's wine.

g.title: j108897025
g.text: MomToxicated: I was busy, but it doesn't mean I wasn't listening. You were my cover. And you almost blew it for me when I laughed.

g.title: j202924706
g.text: PapaPolar: and if i remember correctly, we went to that place with the amazing escargot after, didn't we?

g.title: j515386396
g.text: MomToxicated: We did. And had to leave very quickly when the Rus showed up angry as a swarm of bees.

g.title: j3318108739
g.text: MomToxicated: Never got to finish that bottle of wine.

g.title: j566343926
g.text: PapaPolar: well, Longshot McExtremelyBritannic and friends came up with a new batch of moonshine

g.title: j1581193940
g.text: PapaPolar: not exactly a bottle of red worth my year's salary but hey. care to pick up where we left off?

g.title: j2023687805
g.text: MomToxicated: Mm. Beggars and choosers and all that jazz. Count me in.
